purpose: Coverage-only prospective diagnostic for the existing Formal institutionalScore decomposition. No outcomes, threshold/weight search, or Formal changes.

derivedOnlyWhenInputsObserved.preClampInstitutionalScore: sum of the four contribution groups

failClosedEvidenceStates.CLEAN: FULL_FORMAL_SCAN and all raw nets, aggregate net, chip concentration, positive ADV denominator and streak values are observed; recomputed score matches stored score within numeric tolerance.
failClosedEvidenceStates.FORMAL_REPRODUCIBLE_BUT_SOURCE_INCOMPLET: stored Formal score may be reproducible under deployed zero/fallback semantics, but one or more raw evidence inputs needed for economic interpretation are absent.
failClosedEvidenceStates.UNKNOWN_INPUT: required decomposition input is null/nonfinite or ADV denominator is nonpositive.
failClosedEvidenceStates.SCORE_MISMATCH: recomputed score does not match stored institution.score; treat as generation/schema/provenance conflict, not an economic observation.

metricsByIndependentScanDate: ownershipContributionShare distribution among clean nonzero-preClamp rows
criticalCaveat: research-snapshot-v1 stores buy-day streaks with journalInteger(value)||0, so the persisted zero cannot by itself distinguish a true zero-day streak from a missing source value. FULL_FORMAL_SCAN proves prospective selection-time capture but does not embed the institution-history readiness receipt or institutionHistoryDays in the snapshot. Therefore actor-streak source completeness is not self-authenticating from the snapshot alone.
biasGuards: No D1/D3/D5/D10/D20/MFE/MAE or other outcome fields may be read in this coverage phase.
No historical Shadow reconstruction or present-day backfill.
Do not treat missing raw nets as zero for actor-divergence research semantics.
Report scanDate-level coverage and date concentration; do not treat rows as independent dates.
No threshold/weight sweep and no alternative institutionalScore formula.

persistedPopulationCaveat.currentTradeResearchSnapshots: FULL_FORMAL_SCAN rows are attached to selected plans under current persistence wiring.
persistedPopulationCaveat.shadowPopulation: Non-selected research rows are stored separately as SHADOW_PROSPECTIVE and bounded by cohort/pool caps.
persistedPopulationCaveat.implication: Current persisted FULL_FORMAL_SCAN rows can support selected-conditioned coverage/replay diagnostics only. They cannot estimate complete Formal-scan saturation/divergence prevalence.
persistedPopulationCaveat.historicalRepair: Bounded Shadow must not be unioned with selected rows and relabeled a complete population.
persistedPopulationCaveat.fullPopulationNeed: Use a certified complete same-scan in-memory parent or future immutable full-population receipt before full-scan prevalence claims.
